items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I heard him a few times. ... I know he could read it

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, how was the Whitman Joe as a musician? Did he know all the horn real well and different keys? Was he able to read? No, I never did know. I heard him a few times.
Well, for my life, he reads some posts, I mean, that I know of. I wouldn't say he was one of the greatest, but I know he could read it, you know what I mean?
